name: Canus Espada
source:
A headless knight (Dullahan) from the fairy world 'Medio'.
If you take his helmet off there is nothing underneath.
He looks completely suspicious but he is actually a very honest knightly and serious person.
He's good-natured and can't ignore people who are weak or in trouble.
He's a master at fencing and despite his appearance his hobby is gardening.
